title: Honor explicit 0% discounts in Sales and Purchase price lists
summary: Fixed price calculation to honor explicit 0% discounts in Sales and Purchase price lists by distinguishing discount declarations from incidental zero amounts, allowing specific zero-discount lines to override generic positive discounts.
key_points: A line declares a discount when amount type is `Discount` or discount percentage is positive
Explicit 0% can win through existing specificity rules; 0% in Price & Discount remains incidental
Candidate acceptance happens before OnAfterIsBetterLine event, preserving subscriber vetoes
At equal specificity, highest eligible discount still wins; explicit zero is not unconditional veto
Covers Sales and Purchase price lists with variant and currency specificity; affects Shopify product price calculator
